presentation.headline: The copy is not the whole migration
presentation.lede: Inspect population, relationships, access, recovery, transition and control as separate results with visible acceptance boundaries.
presentation.decision: Bound M-I002 correction and retest within M1.2, confirm package ownership and route any phasing through actual change control.

analysis.method: Deliverable-oriented forest with nested population packages, requirement coverage and dictionary evidence.
analysis.hundred_percent_boundary: Coverage is tested against M-D001/B1 and the local trace keys in this snapshot; open detail remains visible rather than called out of scope.
analysis.overlap_rule: Each active requirement has one primary package boundary; shared inputs and support links are not estimated twice.
analysis.decomposition_rule: Population, mapping, relationship correctness, access, recovery, transition and project control need distinct outputs and acceptance.
analysis.authority_boundary: This workspace proposes decomposition; Saira and project governance retain their actual business and change authority.
